new: Native AgentRuntime code writes acquire code-path claims before modifying the isolated workspace, and the managed code-workspace apply path reasserts those claims before writing the live project while still performing the existing common-baseline stale-file check. Native AgentRuntime MCP mutations acquire one conservative `canonical_authoring` shared-resource claim before typed live Editor MCP dispatch; read-only MCP calls do not acquire it. Governed external/generated asset acquisition acquires a hierarchical `project_assets/<destination>` asset-target claim after permissions are granted and before provider execution; the synthetic `project_assets` root represents import into the assets root and conflicts with every nested asset destination. Human edits therefore remain unlocked and may still invalidate an agent mutation after ownership was acquired. Structured authoring continues to use ADR 0121/0139 authoritative revisions and transactions; a claim is never permission to bypass stale-revision rejection.
